payload.title: Stability-regularized wide residual datum model
payload.statement: Existing cross-fitted wide legal datum actions may retain a small stable signed correction on top of E011, and only then may inner-fold feature/coefficient stability justify a new refit.
payload.evidence_for: E009 ridge_all_a25_f64 gained 0.297867 RMSE over E006 with 5/5 map wins and better p90; path/evidence action supplied a distinct second formulation.
payload.evidence_against: E009 won only 15/25 cells and failed spatial/typewell transfer. E011 is 2.38 RMSE stronger than E006, so E009-relative headroom may have disappeared. T023 also showed that generic smooth corrections can pass aggregate gates while failing signed controls and spatial transfer.
payload.next_test: Complete the frozen T016 E011-relative placement screen. No feature or model refit is allowed unless nested placement passes every repeated, tail, spatial/typewell, special-slice, negative-control, edge, and reproduction gate.
